notes.title: Deadly Land starts a small beta test
notes.content:
If you like NAR's Zombie-Mode, you may also be interested in the game "Deadly Land"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1234260/Deadly_Land/

[previewyoutube=aFmKReEz9pM;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadly Land is a first-person zombie shooter. This game will be released soon and needs a few more testers.

Check out this event :)
